qc.label_under_test: In English instructions or advice addressed to the reader, offering YOU an optional or alternative way to do something ('or you can...', 'you can also...', 'if you prefer, you could...'), strongest on 'can/could', the verb after it or the 'and' joining a second step. The same actions told as past-tense narrative stay low, as do passive or third-person options ('it can be...', 'applicants may...') and other languages; a camelCase code key piece can leak.

neighbours.label: In practical how-to text (web forms, documents, medicines), the 'and' / 'and then' that adds a second step after a first action, and that second step's verb (e.g. 'register online and then print'); any person or tense. Plain 'you can also...' offers and single-step instructions stay low.
fire: Fill in the application form online and then print a copy for your records.
Take two tablets with water and then wait at least four hours before the next dose.
Click 'Save' and close the document before emailing it to the office.
She logged in to the portal and then uploaded her signed contract.
Shake the bottle well and measure 5 ml with the enclosed spoon.
Enter your postcode in the search box and then select your address from the list.
We scanned the receipt and attached it to the expense claim.
Remove the old filter, and then insert the new cartridge until it clicks.
quiet: Fill in the application form online to begin your request.
Take two tablets with water every four hours as needed.
Click 'Save' before you close the document.
She logged in to the portal yesterday morning.
Shake the bottle well before use.
Enter your postcode in the search box at the top of the page.
